## About the team

L2IB is a research team of the [CIRI — Centre International de Recherche en
Infectiologie](https://ciri.ens-lyon.fr/teams/lib) in Lyon, France
(Inserm U1111 · CNRS UMR5308 · ENS de Lyon · Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1),
co-led by **Laurent Genestier** and **Emmanuel Bachy**.

Forty-three people work at the interface of fundamental immunology,
haematology and computational biology. We combine primary patient samples,
functional immunology, mouse models and machine learning on large clinical
cohorts to understand lymphomagenesis and to improve how patients are
diagnosed, stratified and treated.

The team is based on the Lyon Sud campus and works in close collaboration with
the clinical haematology and pathology departments of the Hospices Civils de
Lyon.

## What we do

The team is organised into six groups. Each one is described below — follow a
card to its research axis and the people who work on it.

::: {.feature-grid}

::: {.feature-card}
### [Epigenetics and T-cell lymphoma](research.qmd#axis-1)
Chromatin alterations in T-cell lymphoma, and ATAC-seq protocols that work on
routine FFPE material.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### [Environment and genomics](research.qmd#axis-2)
BTG1 mutations, MCL1 sensitivity, and how glyphosate exposure shapes lymphoma
risk and chemoresistance.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### [Metabolism and microenvironment](research.qmd#axis-3)
Metabolism and the bone marrow niche in B-cell leukaemia, from pre-leukaemic
clones to relapse.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### [Inflammation and VEXAS](research.qmd#axis-4)
The IL-1 axis in myeloid malignancies, and the first PDX model of VEXAS
syndrome.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### [Immunotherapy and CAR-T](research.qmd#axis-5)
Determinants of CAR-T efficacy and toxicity, and anti-CD4 CAR-T cells for
T-cell malignancies.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### [Non-canonical transcriptomics](research.qmd#axis-6)
What the non-coding genome transcribes, and how it shapes immune recognition in
blood disorders.
:::

:::

Running across all six, a transversal
[omics, bioinformatics and AI programme](research.qmd#transversal) supports every
axis and produces our [open apps](app/index.qmd).

## Highlights

- **Transcriptomic prediction of treatment-free remission in chronic myeloid
  leukaemia** — a 50-gene signature measured at TKI discontinuation, externally
  validated. Alcazer V, et al. *Journal of Clinical Oncology* 2026.
  [doi:10.1200/JCO-25-02948](https://doi.org/10.1200/JCO-25-02948)
- **[FIBOM-AI](app/fibom-ai/index.qmd) — predicting bone marrow fibrosis from a
  complete blood count** in myeloproliferative neoplasms, a multicentre model
  development and validation study. Donzel M, et al. *Lancet Haematology* 2026.
  [doi:10.1016/S2352-3026(26)00099-2](https://doi.org/10.1016/S2352-3026(26)00099-2)
- **[AIPAL](app/aipal/index.qmd) — machine-learning prediction of acute
  leukaemia subtype** from ten routine laboratory parameters, validated on 1,410
  patients. Alcazer V, et al. *Lancet Digital Health* 2024.
  [doi:10.1016/S2589-7500(24)00044-X](https://doi.org/10.1016/S2589-7500(24)00044-X)
- **Real-world comparison of tisagenlecleucel and axicabtagene ciloleucel**
  CAR T cells in relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma. Bachy E, et al.
  *Nature Medicine* 2022.
  [doi:10.1038/s41591-022-01969-y](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41591-022-01969-y)
- ***BTG1* inactivation drives lymphomagenesis** and sensitises lymphomas to
  MCL1 inhibitors — protected by patent WO2023057484A1. Delage L, et al.
  *Blood* 2023.
  [doi:10.1182/blood.2022016943](https://doi.org/10.1182/blood.2022016943)
